name: Master of Apprentice
prerequisites: master in Crafting, Performance, or a Lore skill
text: Teaching is a difficult art form, but you've gotten a pretty good handle on it. When you Craft or Earn Income during downtime, you can also attempt to Aid another creature doing the same with the same skill if they have a lower proficiency bonus than you. If you succeed, they can use the better result between your check and their own check.
